home.steps_title: Three steps between you and your first donor
home.step1_text: Tell your story, set a goal and pick a category. Your draft stays private until you are ready.
home.step2_text: Send your campaign link to family, friends and your community — on WhatsApp, Facebook or email.
home.step3_text: Donors give via bKash, Nagad, bank transfer, Stripe or Wise. Track everything and withdraw from your dashboard.
home.trust1_text: Organizers apply with identity documents and are reviewed by our team before they can launch a campaign.
home.trust2_text: Every campaign is checked by a human before it goes live. Verified campaigns carry a badge.
home.trust3_text: Every donation produces a receipt and an entry in the campaign's public ledger. No silent money.
home.trust4_text: The exact fee breakdown is shown before you give — no surprises on the receipt.
home.trust_note: We don't process card payments ourselves. Payments are completed through the provider you choose — bKash, Nagad, Stripe or Wise — and recorded here with a receipt.
home.story_text_verified: This verified campaign is live on the platform today. Every figure below comes straight from its public ledger.
home.faq1_q: How do I start a campaign?
home.faq1_a: Create an account, apply as an organizer, then click “Start a Campaign”. Write your story, set a goal and submit it. Our team reviews every campaign before it goes live.
home.faq2_q: Which payment methods can donors use?
home.faq2_a: For BDT campaigns: bKash, Nagad and bank transfer. For USD campaigns: Stripe, Wise and bank transfer. You choose the method when you donate.
home.faq3_a: You get a confirmation on screen, and the donation is recorded in the campaign's public ledger with its receipt. Organizers see it in their dashboard immediately.
home.faq4_a: A :platform% platform fee and a payment processing fee of :processing% + :flat are deducted from each donation. The fee breakdown is shown before you give, and the rest reaches the organizer.
home.faq5_a: From their organizer dashboard once donations are completed. There is a :withdrawal% withdrawal fee and a minimum withdrawal of :minimum per request.
home.faq6_a: Yes. Tick “Donate anonymously” and your name is never shown — the ledger records the donation without your identity.
home.faq7_a: Organizers submit identity documents with their application, and every campaign is reviewed by a human before it goes live. Verified campaigns carry a badge.
home.cta_title: Every act of kindness can change a life.
home.cta_text: Start your campaign today — someone, somewhere, is waiting for the help only you can rally.
